# Knowledge Park Guide

> An independent student guide to Knowledge Park, Greater Noida (Uttar Pradesh, India): metro routes and fares to the universities around it, and official contacts for the colleges in Knowledge Park II and III. Written by a final-year Bennett University student. Fares, distances and timings come from official sources such as NMRC or from the author's own trips, and fare tables show when they were last checked.

Knowledge Park is in Greater Noida, not Greater Noida West. Bennett University (Tech Zone II) and Galgotias University (Yamuna Expressway) are near Knowledge Park, not inside it.

## Guides

- [Bennett University nearest metro station](https://knowledgeparkguide.in/getting-here/bennett-university-nearest-metro-station/): Depot is the nearest Aqua Line station, but most students use Pari Chowk, 11 km away. Auto and cab fares, buses and the route from Delhi.
- [Nearest metro station for Galgotias, Sharda and GL Bajaj](https://knowledgeparkguide.in/getting-here/nearest-metro-station-galgotias-sharda-gl-bajaj/): no metro is within walking distance of Galgotias University; Sharda and GL Bajaj are 2.5-3 km from the metro.
- [Colleges in Knowledge Park, Greater Noida](https://knowledgeparkguide.in/living/colleges-in-knowledge-park-greater-noida/): 22 colleges and institutes in Knowledge Park II and III with official admission and office contacts, and the walk from Knowledge Park II metro.

## Sections

- [Getting here](https://knowledgeparkguide.in/getting-here/): metro, auto, e-rickshaw and bus routes to Knowledge Park and nearby campuses.
- [Living](https://knowledgeparkguide.in/living/): college contacts and practical information for students living in Greater Noida.

## About

- [About Knowledge Park Guide](https://knowledgeparkguide.in/about/): who writes the guide, how facts are checked and how to report an error.
